title: Battle of Hackers
subtitle: The internal years
description: Battle of Hackers began in 2016 as an in-house capture-the-flag for APU students. By 2022 it had grown into a full-day jeopardy board spanning reverse engineering, web, boot2root, forensics and cryptography, with RM4,000 in prizes on the table.

title: ASEAN Battle of Hackers
subtitle: Opening the doors to the region
description: The first edition open beyond APU. Teams competed in separate ASEAN and Malaysia categories for RM15,000 in prizes, and the board gained OSINT and threat-hunting challenges.

title: International Battle of Hackers
subtitle: Return of the Legends
description: Battle of Hackers went international on 28 September 2024, backed by PayNet, MDEC, Ant International and others, and drew university teams from across Asia.

title: International Battle of Hackers
subtitle: Stage 1: Jeopardy
description: A hybrid edition on 8 November 2025, played on campus and online from 08:00 to 18:00, with AWS, CREST, Kaspersky and CyberSecurity Malaysia among the sponsors.

title: International Battle of Hackers
subtitle: 14 November 2026
description: The next battle. Hybrid mode, APU campus, 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM, open to local and international students. Registration and the CTF platform open closer to the date.
